WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT ci.city_id, ci.city, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count
  FROM city ci
  LEFT JOIN address a ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
  GROUP BY ci.city_id, ci.city
)
SELECT city_id,
       address_count,
       address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average,
       address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses
FROM city_counts
ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10;
